content: Sabate ꞌana loina
Sabate ꞌebweuna ꞌenaya Yesu ꞌitauya sabi ꞌeꞌai Palisiyao ꞌidi ꞌinapwana ꞌebweu ꞌina anuwaya. Anuwa nina ꞌena ꞌilugulugu ta boda siduneduneye,
manuna sena nina ꞌenaya ꞌebweu toleꞌoasa ꞌimiyami, bwalana maiboꞌana siꞌeloseseya.

ꞌEnega Yesu toleꞌoasa nina manuna ꞌienaida loina ꞌana tosinasinapuyao be Palisiyao ꞌediya, ꞌigwae, “Mwaꞌadega? Wanuwena ꞌaene boboꞌana ꞌabo toleꞌoasa ꞌasiyata Sabate ꞌenaya tagieboboꞌane, nai nigeya?”
Ga ꞌina ona nina nigeya sieꞌieꞌisa, ga muliyega Yesu toleꞌoasa nina nimana ꞌigiyaina, ga ꞌana leꞌoasa ꞌigie boboꞌanena. ꞌEnega ꞌietunena ga ꞌitauya ꞌina ꞌasaya.

ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌiasakowasi ꞌediya ga ꞌigwae, “ꞌAbo yaisigei ꞌomi ma imi yobaiyao nadigega ase be bulumakau ta ꞌebweuna yobai nina ꞌasiyata Sabate ꞌena ꞌibebeꞌu gaulaya, mwaꞌadega, ꞌilobwenena be walisi tuꞌeyei?”
Ta taudi tuga nigeya ꞌebweu wate ꞌidi eꞌisamo.
Geyaꞌabo ꞌebemiya boboꞌadi waesiesinuwedi
ꞌEꞌai nina solanaya Yesu tomota ꞌaidi ꞌiꞌitedi, ꞌebemiya boboꞌana ꞌena simiyatowa, ꞌenega ꞌebweu onasemalimali ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi, ꞌigwae,
“ꞌAbo yaita ꞌina anuwaya ꞌibwauyeyo ai sagalina manuna, geyaꞌabo toai ꞌatainaya ꞌumiyamiyatowa, manuna nai ꞌebweu tai sinabwana ꞌeguma ꞌimama,
tonisagali nina ꞌieonayo be ꞌutatauya tupitupiya, ta ꞌimu ꞌebemiya nina ꞌenaya tai auwauna nina ꞌida miyatowa. Ta ꞌoyo ꞌiabe ma imu omayamaya tupiya ꞌuaila.

ꞌEnega ꞌabo sibwauyeyo be ꞌululugu ꞌediya, ꞌebemiya tupiya ꞌuesinuwe be ꞌena ꞌumiyatowa, be ꞌenega tuta nina ꞌabo tonisagali ꞌimama be ꞌiꞌitayo ꞌiabe ꞌemuya ꞌida ona, ꞌigwae, ‘Gosiyagu, ꞌumiyalaga gamwagamwanaya,’ be ꞌenega ꞌulalaga ma imu gwausowala, ta wate ma ꞌamu tupu tomota matadiya.
Gete ꞌenega tamwalatoni ꞌaene yaita tauna ꞌigituꞌeye ꞌetamo ꞌiebusi; ta ꞌabo yaita tauna ꞌigimwaꞌute ꞌiabe ꞌitutuꞌe.”

ꞌEnega Yesu Palisi nina ꞌibwauyena ga ꞌena ꞌigwae, “ꞌAbo ꞌemasula nai ꞌeꞌai gidalina ꞌuguinuwe, geyaꞌabo gosemwao nai tasimwao nai ꞌimu buꞌunao nai toesaesao ꞌubwaubwauyedi ꞌeꞌai nina ꞌenaya, manuna taudi maꞌetamo sibwauyeyo sabi eꞌisa ꞌemuya.
Ta esiya ꞌabo ꞌemasula ꞌuguinuwe, taudi gomagomabesodi be bwalobwalogodi be tolopegoi be wate tomatakebokebo ꞌuda bwauyedi,

be ꞌenega ꞌawaboboꞌana ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌuloba, manuna gete taudi nigeya sawesawediya be ꞌimu oboboma nina sieꞌisa. Ta esi Yaubada ꞌenega ꞌamu eꞌisa ꞌuda loba, tuta nina ꞌabo toboboꞌadi mwawasega ꞌigietoolodi.”
ꞌInapwana ꞌebweu ꞌemasula sinabwana ꞌiguinuwena
Ga niꞌatu maꞌenao siꞌeꞌai ta ꞌebweuna ꞌediyega ona gete ꞌinonona ga Yesu ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “O nadigega! ꞌAbo yaisigedi silulugu Yaubada ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌenaya be siꞌaꞌa, sida gwausowala sinabwana.”
ꞌEnega Yesu tai nina ꞌina ona ꞌieꞌisena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌEbweu tai ꞌemasula sinabwana ꞌiguinuwena ga tomotai yaudi ꞌibwauyedi.
Ta niꞌatu masula ꞌigibubuna ga ꞌina ꞌaliꞌei ꞌietunena tomotai nidi ꞌediya ga ꞌieonedi, ‘Niꞌatu masula sigibubuna, ꞌenega wamai be tatatauya be ꞌeꞌai nina wada ꞌai.’
“Ta maiboꞌadi geya nuwadi, ꞌenega mali ona be mali ona siꞌebwaꞌena. ꞌEbweuna ꞌigwae, ‘Niꞌatu tanowa auwauna yagimwanena, ꞌenega nai yatatauya be yayausi. Ta kagutoki sinabwana, nai geyaꞌabo yaweewa.’

Ta ꞌebweuna wate ꞌigwae, ‘Kagutoki sinabwana, nai ꞌaboꞌagu wate geyaꞌabo yaweewa, manuna bulumakau sanau ta wate ꞌebe gesowa nima niꞌatu yagimwanedi, ꞌenega yatautauya be ꞌaene yada eguinuwaedi, be yada epaisewa toodi.’
Ta wate ꞌebweu ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌAboꞌagu auwaugu yaai, ꞌenega nai geyaꞌabo yaweewai.’

“ꞌEnega ꞌaliꞌei nina ꞌiila ga ꞌina ꞌinapwana ꞌenaya ꞌisimana, ꞌigwae, ‘Maiboꞌadi geya nuwadi.’ Ga tonianuwa nina ꞌigamwasowala, ꞌenega ꞌina ꞌaliꞌei nina ꞌena ꞌiona, ‘ꞌUtauya manini ꞌasa sinabwana ꞌedanao maiboꞌadi ꞌediya be ꞌeguma ꞌeisa tomotai ꞌulobadi, ꞌanabwaꞌayoi nanaewadi nai nenetadi nai matakebokebodi nai bwalobwalogodi, tuga maiboꞌadi ꞌuꞌauꞌewedima be sida ꞌa.’
“Ga ꞌaliꞌei nina ꞌiguinuwa nadigega, ta muliyega ꞌimai ga ꞌiona, ‘Niꞌatu tomota nidi yabwauyedima ta esi ꞌimu anuwa nina nigeya siloeloemaa.’
ꞌEnega ꞌinapwana nina wate ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌEda maiboꞌadi ꞌediya ꞌuda tauya be tomotai ꞌueonadi be simama, be ꞌenega ꞌigu anuwa sida loemaa.
Ta esi tomotai nidi yagimi bwauyedi geyaꞌabo ꞌebweu ꞌediyega ꞌagu masula ꞌilotolotoo.’”
Mwaꞌadega Yesu ꞌana muliya
Ta niꞌatu pwalu sinabwadi maꞌenao sitautauya, ga ꞌenega Yesu ꞌisanaila ga boda nidi ꞌieonedi,

“Yaita ꞌabo nuwanuwana be ꞌimuliyegu, nugana ꞌida yalaꞌaiꞌailigu ta tamana be sinana be mwanena be natunao be tasinao be nuunao ta wate tauna tuga manuna ꞌida guitoyasedi. Ta ꞌeguma nigeya, tauna nigeya ꞌagu tomuliya.
Ta ꞌabo yaita yawasina nigeya ꞌitagwatagwalei be ꞌimwamwawasa kelose ꞌenaya nadigega ꞌaboꞌagu, tauna nigeya sawesawenaya be ꞌimuliyegu.
Nadigega tuga ꞌabo yaita nuwanuwana be anuwa sinabwana ꞌiꞌabi, nugana yage maiboꞌadi ꞌida gibubudi ꞌabi nina manuna,
ꞌabona nai ꞌola namo ꞌietoolodi be geyaꞌabo anuwa maiboꞌana ꞌilosalosaloni. Gete ꞌenega ꞌiabe tomota siꞌita be tai nina situyeye
be sida gwae, ‘Tai gete ꞌatuwa waiwaina ga ꞌola ꞌietoolodi ta nigeya anuwa nina maiboꞌana ꞌiꞌabiꞌabi.’

Ta wate ꞌeguma ꞌebweu kini niꞌatu ma ina tolosaiyao teni tausani sitautauya sabi losaiya wate mali kini ma ina bodao tuweniti tausani ꞌadi yau ꞌediya, mwaꞌadega kini nina ꞌiabe ꞌinuwanuwaꞌesa? Nai nugana ꞌida miyatowa ta ꞌida nuwanuwa be ꞌaene sawesawediya siewaiwai ꞌadi talauwalao nidi ꞌediya, nai nigeya?
Ta ꞌeguma nigeya, ꞌina toepilialealeyao nidi ꞌietuetunedi be sipilipili bodedi, ꞌabo mali kini nina ma ina boda ꞌetamo ꞌedasolaya simiyami, be ꞌenega maꞌediyao sida eonaona nuwasiwalowa manuna.”
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌina emataluwa ꞌilosalonina, ga ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Gete nadigega wate ꞌagu muliya ꞌana ꞌeda. ꞌEguma yaita ꞌoyo nuwanuwayo be ꞌumuliyegu, nugana ꞌimu ꞌebeloina maiboꞌana ꞌuda pilisinedi.
Ola yage boboꞌana
“Ola yage boboꞌana. Ta ꞌeguma ꞌina waiwai ꞌigugumwala, nigeya sawesawenaya be ꞌiboboꞌana limana.
Nigeya wate ꞌilobwelobwene be bwaꞌa ꞌigieboboꞌane, ta esi tada guitoyase namo. “ꞌEguma matenami ona gete wada nono.”
